rules.headline: certified functions deduplicated by definition site (defining file + name); module-prefixed re-inclusions of dependency modules never count
rules.denominator: all corpus functions by the same definition-site rule (certified + declined, own unit, un-prefixed)
rules.per_unit_sum: sum of manifest certified lists; double-counts dependency functions once per including entrypoint
rules.certified_vs_closes: certified = producer emitted a claim (no Lean run); closes = `aver cert check` accepts it. Only --closure measures the latter.
